description: Use this after calling generate_image, generate_video, generate_music, generate_sound_effect, generate_3d_model, or generate_depth_map to poll for results. Pass a job_id to check a specific job — numeric = image, uuid = video, and for MUSIC / SOUND-EFFECT / 3D-MODEL / DEPTH-MAP jobs also pass type "music" / "sound_effect" / "3d" / "depth" (3D jobs are uuids too, like video) — with no job_id it lists jobs still running that were started on the BudgetPixel website. Completed IMAGE jobs return the finished image(s) inline (as image content) plus a full-resolution link — display the image AND share the link (some chat UIs don't show inline images). Completed VIDEO, MUSIC and SOUND-EFFECT jobs return a watch/listen link — always share it with the user (chat UIs can't embed players). Completed 3D-MODEL jobs return the thumbnail inline plus download links (GLB/FBX/USDZ/STL) and a viewer link — share the links and tell the user downloads expire in about 24 hours. Completed DEPTH-MAP jobs return the depth video, which is saved in the user's BudgetPixel library. Poll every few seconds for images and sound effects (~15 s), every 15–30 seconds for videos, music, 3D models and depth maps (they take minutes). Call repeatedly until status is 'completed' or 'failed'.

job_id.description: Optional job ID to check — a number for image/music/sound-effect/depth-map jobs, a uuid for video and 3D-model jobs. If omitted, returns all active generation jobs (images, videos, music, and sound effects).

type.description: Which pipeline the job_id belongs to. REQUIRED as "music" for music jobs, "sound_effect" for sound-effect jobs, "depth" for generate_depth_map jobs (their numeric ids would otherwise be read as image jobs), and "3d" for generate_3d_model jobs (their uuid would otherwise be read as video). Optional otherwise: other uuids are detected as video, plain numbers default to image.
